nodes.name: CounselorController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing academic-counselor endpoints: career statistics, students missing skills, student search, profile management, feedback CRUD, curriculum listing, student email checks, and Excel-based student list export/import.

nodes.name: CounselorController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller with 15 endpoints handling counselor dashboards, student feedback, profile updates, and bulk student import/export, delegating business logic to CounselorService and FeedbackService.

nodes.name: getCareerStatistics
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning aggregated career statistics for the counselor dashboard.

nodes.name: getStudentsMissingSkills
nodes.summary: Endpoint listing students missing skills required for a given career path.

nodes.name: getFeedbackSentByMe
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning all feedback entries sent by the authenticated counselor.

nodes.name: getStudentInfos
nodes.summary: Paginated endpoint searching and listing students assigned to the counselor.

nodes.name: getStudentStatisticAndFeedback
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning combined roadmap statistics and feedback history for a single student.

nodes.name: getProfile
nodes.summary: Endpoint fetching the authenticated counselor's profile details.

nodes.name: updateProfile
nodes.summary: Endpoint updating the counselor's own profile information.

nodes.name: createFeedback
nodes.summary: Endpoint creating feedback for a student, optionally with file attachments.

nodes.name: modifyFeedback
nodes.summary: Endpoint modifying existing feedback content and attachments.

nodes.name: markReadFeedback
nodes.summary: Endpoint marking a feedback item as read.

nodes.name: deleteFeedback
nodes.summary: Endpoint deleting a feedback entry created by the counselor.

nodes.name: exportStudentList
nodes.summary: Endpoint exporting a selected list of students to an Excel (.xlsx) attachment.

nodes.name: getCurriculums
nodes.summary: Endpoint listing available curriculums for counselor use.

nodes.name: checkStudentEmail
nodes.summary: Endpoint validating whether a student email already exists before import.

nodes.name: importStudentAccounts
nodes.summary: Endpoint bulk-importing student accounts and returning a result report as an Excel attachment.

nodes.name: MentorController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing industry-mentor dashboard endpoints covering metrics, alerts, pending reviews, student progress, feedback submission, and mentor profile management.

nodes.name: MentorController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller with 11 thin endpoints that delegate all business logic to MentorService, covering dashboard metrics, pending reviews, feedback history, and profile updates for industry mentors.

nodes.name: MentorDirectoryController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing a public/paginated directory listing of industry mentors.

nodes.name: MentorDirectoryController
nodes.summary: Small Spring REST controller with a single paginated endpoint that lists mentors via MentorService.

nodes.name: listMentors
nodes.summary: Endpoint returning a paginated directory of mentors.

nodes.name: CreateFeedbackRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the receiver id, content, and feedback type used when creating a new feedback entry.

nodes.name: ExportStudentListRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO holding the list of student ids to include in an Excel export.

nodes.name: ImportStudentAccountsRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO wrapping a batch of student account entries submitted for bulk import.

nodes.name: ModifyFeedbackRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the feedback id, updated content, and type used when modifying existing feedback.

nodes.name: UpdateMentorProfileRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying company and industry focus fields for updating a mentor's profile.

nodes.name: UpdateProfileRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying personal profile fields (name, admission date, year of birth, bio, department) used to update a counselor's profile.

nodes.name: FeedbackAttachmentResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO describing a feedback file attachment's id, name, type, and size.

nodes.name: CounselorDashboardResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO aggregating career statistics counts and feedback data for the counselor dashboard view.

nodes.name: CounselorFeedbackResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO combining student info, missing skills, feedback list, roadmap progress, and pagination metadata for counselor feedback views.

nodes.name: CounselorFeedbackResponse
nodes.summary: Composite response object nesting student, missing-skills, feedback, and roadmap-progress data along with pagination fields for a counselor's student feedback screen.

nodes.name: CurriculumResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO wrapping a list of curriculums returned to counselors.

nodes.name: MentorCareerDistributionResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a single career distribution data point (name, value, color) for mentor dashboard charts.

nodes.name: MentorDashboardMetricsResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO summarizing mentor dashboard metrics: response time, mentee count, pending reviews, and feedback count.

nodes.name: MentorDirectoryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO exposing public mentor directory fields: user id, name, email, avatar, company, and industry focus.

nodes.name: MentorFeedbackHistoryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a single historical feedback entry with author initials, name, timestamp, tag, and content shown to mentors.

nodes.name: MentorPendingReviewResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO describing a student portfolio pending mentor review, including id, name, year of birth, target career, and university.

nodes.name: MentorProfileResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO exposing a mentor's own profile fields including role, company, industry focus, and bio.

nodes.name: MentorProgressReportResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO aggregating mentee progress metrics, per-student progress details, students needing attention, and skill-gap summaries for the mentor progress report screen.

nodes.name: MentorProgressReportResponse
nodes.summary: Nested response object combining overall metrics, per-student progress rows, attention flags, and skill gap data for the mentor's student progress report.

nodes.name: MentorResponse.java
nodes.summary: Composite response DTO bundling mentor dashboard metrics, pending reviews, students, feedback, insight, and welcome alert into a single payload.

nodes.name: MentorStudentResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a mentee's basic profile fields (id, portfolio slug, name, email, career, university) shown to mentors.

nodes.name: UpdateProfileResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO returning the updated user record along with role-specific profile data (academic counselor, industry mentor, or student) after a profile update.
